label: Structured shared-IO feature process - union530 primitive-consistent causal rollout - K1 2x1s input x 530 - K2 2x1s primitive output x 14 rederived to 530 - W768 - M768 - P768 - F768 - PF768 - NF768 - standardized derived-feature MSE - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - no regularization - weight EMA 4 epochs

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number in the diagram is one exact GNGLU module instance reused at every matching input/output block
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 maps NF to expected W; shared layer 2 decodes W only to primitive causal coordinates; differentiable fixed code reconstructs the complete future union530 state
architecture.baseConsistency: BTC one-second candle geometry, return activity, aggregate trade flow, aggressor side, and book spread are decoded once; all affected engineered production channels are then derived from the same predicted primitive history
architecture.slowGlobalState: all selected sequences stay within one immutable causal minute snapshot, so the 470 slow/global channels are exactly carried from the input state
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

loss.description: decode only 14 primitive causal coordinates, differentiably reconstruct both complete 530-channel future states, then mean MSE over the two steps and all 530 channels after per-feature training-split standardization

sampling.description: original chronological nonzero-target origin population, restricted only to consecutive K1/K2 rows that share the same already-completed causal global minute snapshot

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.comparableMetrics: step-1 and per-step return metrics remain directly comparable to the earlier structured 59-feature runs

alignment.input: two consecutive complete union530 states ending at each clean example origin
alignment.target: the two consecutive complete union530 states at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.causalDerivation: only predicted primitive coordinates and observed history through the input origin enter the changing future channels; no observed future derived input is consumed
